scope: Static production call-path proof that clinical signing, affirmation and reassessment commands do not enter PEM or shared sync replay
command: python3 inline source-boundary check over production web TypeScript and Axum router composition

mechanism.affirmation: useSurgeonGate -> gateApi -> httpClient POST; process-scoped ownership is keyed by feature, verified identity, practice and case and survives hook remount until reconciliation.
mechanism.signing: No production web signing mutation caller exists; server and inactive desktop operations expose no PEM port.
mechanism.reassessment: useEvidenceTimeline reads PGlite but sends practice-scoped reassessment and lookup through timelineApi HTTP; its runtime owner stores correlation only and never writes the local database or graph.
mechanism.shared_sync: Production shared sync sources contain none of the signing, gate-mutation or reassessment command contracts/routes.
mechanism.legacy_count: The actorless evidence-count route remains source-visible but is absent from production router composition until verified-context conversion.

unverified: A future source change could add a command caller; the final artifact validator rechecks the current inventory.
